notes.title: Hexopods 11/21/2017 1.0.1 Update
notes.content:
- - BOOMER - -

     ■ Bomb initial speed increased from 750 to 900

     ■ Bomb acceleration increased from 100 to 300

     ■ Bomb AoE increased from 300 to 325

     ■ C4 AoE increased from 300 to 400

     ■ Turret now shoots 2 bullets at a time rather than 1

- - VENOM - -

     ■ Snake duration decreased from 7 to 6 seconds

     ■ Snake' Slow reworked : 

            -The slow is now dependent of the time the snake 
              passed before hitting a target. It works like this : "3 - (timeAlive/4)" secs
              instead of a constant 2 seconds.
